_comment: Calibrated 2026-08-27 against the 221-fixture set in images/ — see research/RESULTS.md, camera-thresholds. Read by BOTH the app camera gate and the server quality gate. Every number here is answerable: images/check.py measures the set, images/calibrate.py scores these numbers against it. Do not move one without a named fixture and a RESULTS.md row.
_blur: Two numbers, because there are two gates and they see different pixels. The capture gate measures a 240x180 downscale, which destroys the very defect it is looking for: it misses 14 of 43 known-blurred fixtures. It is an advisory only. The hard reject happens server-side at full resolution, where the same 43 are all caught.
_fill: fill_fraction_max is deliberately 1.0, i.e. off. The busy box spanning the frame is what a product photograph looks like — at 0.90 this refused 44 of 93 good fixtures as 'too close', including every patterned-background one. Nothing needs it: all 21 too-far fixtures sit at fill 0.11, far below fill_fraction_min.
_camera_only: Below here is the live capture gate only — the server has no preview frames to run these against.
